tagline.en_US: Manage files and users through a web interface, and transfer files over SFTP. The first administrator is created through the setup page; the profile persists SFTPGo configuration and file storage.

description.en_US: SFTPGo is an event-driven file transfer solution supporting SFTP, HTTP/S, FTP/S, and WebDAV protocols. It connects to multiple storage backends, including local filesystems, encrypted local storage, S3-compatible object storage, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Blob Storage. Built-in web administration and web client interfaces allow users to manage permissions and transfer files internally or with external partners.
